role: non-author audit of pane3 receipt typing

pre_registration.selection: mulberry32 + Fisher-Yates, first 8 of 17, no replacement
pre_registration.agreement_bar: >=7/8 exact type agreement; all sampled score and hold-resolution rows must agree

sample.content_evidence: route-backtest receipt has denominator, sessions, perModel, totals, turns, priceTable, and failures; no grade or standing ruling is the primary act
JSON contains h1/h4 label-free checks, counts, transcript shapes, failures, and UNASKABLE threshold outcomes; no top-level score/standing verdict act
same opened measurement object as COD-H1; shared receipt does not change its primary speech act
document has a dedicated Verdict section and standing supersession/slot conclusion; scores are arguments for the ruling
explicit deterministic sentinel measurement with threshold table, recall, false-positive, and precision columns; no Jev call or production verdict as primary act
explicit RULED OUT ruling with retry tracks; structural reasoning supports the standing decision
JSON is a marker census with study denominator, distribution, failures, repositories, and interpretation; threshold outcome is measurement output
JSON maps two label sets, verifies row identity and SHA links, and reports discrepancies; it is mapping/derivation, not score, measurement, verdict, or hold disposition

agreement.critical_type_bar: NOT_EXERCISED: no sampled row was score or hold-resolution
agreement.caveat: The 8/8 result validates the sampled content discriminators but does not test the two most failure-sensitive enum classes.

enum_ruling.reason: other is the honest non-inferential fallback and prevents design/mapping artifacts from being miscalled scores or verdicts. But two recurring speech acts are visible: design/proposal and mapping/derivation. An 18% other share is high enough to indict the vocabulary for analytics and future routing, though not high enough to invalidate the current fail-closed enum.
enum_ruling.recommendation: Keep other as the required fallback; add design and mapping (or derivation) in the next enum migration, with a reason field retained for unresolved cases.

discriminator_audit.basis: Every sampled assignment was made from opened JSON keys/values or markdown status/ruling content. Receipt paths were used for lookup only, never as type evidence.
discriminator_audit.remaining_risk: Pane3's full 17-row document must be re-audited when score and hold-resolution rows are sampled; this sample did not exercise those classes.

ruling: Pane3's sampled typing is sound at 8/8 and satisfies the pre-registered overall bar. The enum's other fallback is correct but signals a vocabulary gap, not a typing error. No filename-derived discriminator was found.
no_claim: No claim of full-population independent agreement, no exercised critical-type agreement, and no claim that the enum is complete for future receipt classes.
